evidence_type: production code inspection plus isolated actual workspace selection callbacks; no persistence callbacks executed
crop_to_structures: Structures.refresh preserves initial specimen if eligible -> _load_specimen -> _notify_selection
structures_to_crops: Crops.refresh -> _load_plate uses preferred specimen only if present on selected plate
break_points: Crops._canvas_down empty space clears session selection and notifies specimen_id empty
Crops._load_plate clears selected specimen if preferred ID not on newly selected plate; no first-specimen default
Crops._notify_selection strips draft: IDs; new draft/deleted selection not immediately notified until Apply/reload
Structures.refresh: eligible current specimen > saved batch position > first specimen on preferred plate > first globally
Crops.refresh: valid preferred plate > saved batch position > first plate

operations.operation: Crop geometry / manual crop creation / deletion
operations.selection_updated: existing selection clicks yes; draft ID sanitized to empty; draft creation/deletion lacks immediate notification
operations.gap: PlateCropEditSession only until Apply; leaving/reloading loses unapplied edits
operations.full_rerender: stage switch yes; local edit overlays only

operations.gap: none after successful Apply; coordinate-dependent annotations deliberately invalidated by crop edits

operations.selection_updated: same crop ID; geometry metadata staged until Apply
operations.gap: unapplied session state invisible to Structures
existing crop raster belongs to workspace; next stage load recomputes from current policy
operations.full_rerender: setter persists metadata; existing raster requires reload; creation dialog sets initial policy

operations.persisted_immediately: on mouse release, not during drag
operations.gap: in-memory drag coordinates before release only

operations.selection_updated: same current specimen; Next can subsequently change it
operations.gap: none; verify_annotations writes verified run then recalculates trait results

runtime_caches: Crops.session: staged geometry/orientation/deletions; lost on plate load or stage destroy before Apply
Crops.preview / photo / _photo_key: current raster only, no keyed multi-plate RAM preview cache
Structures._source_cache: one source plate in RAM, cleared on destroy, no source stat/hash validation on same-plate hit
Structures.crop_image / annotations / roles / _raster_key / photo: reloaded on _load_specimen; destroyed across stages
Runtime._images: icons only; no cross-stage specimen image cache

queue_primitives.visual: app/ui/section_base.py SectionView.attention_banner: compact yellow banner, Continue, close button
queue_primitives.existing_close_semantics: hides banner via attention_banner_dismissed_generation_id; does NOT terminate queue
queue_primitives.completion: Crops._move_batch end uses ids=[] and finished=True; stage exit does not clear queue
queue_primitives.science_separation: UI-state-only queue update is separate from crop/verification/model/provenance tables
queue_primitives.do_not_reuse: clear_all / crop deletion are scientific-data operations, not queue dismissal
